styles.name: Baseball Caps
styles.description: Plan custom baseball caps around crown profile, bill shape, fit, closure and artwork placement with a clear product specification.

detail.alt: Headwear fabric and trim swatches arranged for material planning
detail.caption: Material and trim reference

styles.overview_title: Start With The Crown And Bill.
styles.overview_copy: Describe the cap profile you want to review. Crown height, panel layout, bill curve and closure all shape the finished silhouette.
points: Panel layout, height and structure reference.
Size range, adjustment type and head circumference.
styles.options_intro: Share the decisions that define the profile before artwork and finishing are approved.
options: Crown & Panels
Mark the crown height, panel arrangement and any structured or softer feel you want assessed.
Bill Shape
Use a physical sample or drawing to show the curve, length and stitch detail.
Closure & Fit
Specify an adjustable or fixed fit, the closure reference and your intended size range.
styles.process_title: From Profile Reference To Approved Sample.
process: Share The Brief
Send a cap reference, target quantity, artwork and destination.
Confirm The Silhouette
Record crown, bill, closure, material and fit details in the product brief.
Review Scope & Sample
Confirm quotation terms and whether a sample or artwork proof is included.
Approve Production Details
Check the agreed specification, decoration placement, packing and inspection points.
faq: Can I choose a curved or flat bill?
Yes. Include a sample, sketch or clear photo that shows the curve and length you want reviewed. The approved sample or written specification records the final shape.
What fit information should I provide?
Share your size range, head measurement reference and preferred adjustment or closure. The fit details are confirmed for the selected cap construction.
Can artwork go on more than the front panel?
Send each location and its artwork reference, such as side or back placement. The decoration method and available space are checked against the selected cap.

styles.name: Visors
styles.description: Plan custom visors around the open crown, headband fit, bill profile, closure and artwork placement for a focused headwear range.
styles.lead: A visor pairs an open crown with a shaped bill and fitted band. Define coverage, comfort and adjustment details before choosing decoration.

Closure type, size range and fit preference.
styles.options_intro: Use measurements or a sample to make the visor band and bill easier to assess.
options: Headband
Set the band height, inside finish and the amount of structure you want reviewed.
Bill

Fit & Closure

Send a visor sample or sketch, quantity, artwork and destination.

Review Quote & Sample
Agree the production scope and whether sampling or a proof is included.
Approve The Specification
Check fit, decoration position, packing and inspection details before production.
faq: Can the visor band be adjusted?
Share the closure style or a sample reference and the fit range you need reviewed. The accepted adjustment details are recorded in the quote and specification.
How should I describe bill coverage?
Provide a side view, dimensions or a physical reference for bill length and curve. The agreed sample confirms the final profile.
Where can a logo be placed?
Send the artwork and mark the preferred band or bill location. Available space and the suitable decoration method are confirmed for the chosen material.

Share the mesh type or a close reference, the panel coverage and a back view. These details are checked with the chosen crown and closure.

Mark the desired location and share the artwork. Feasibility depends on the mesh and application, and is confirmed before the production specification is approved.

styles.name: Snapbacks

Include a color reference and note the bill layers or stitching you want reviewed. The combination is confirmed with the sample or written approval.

styles.name: Dad Hats
styles.description: Plan custom dad hats around a relaxed crown, curved bill, adjustable back strap, washed fabric references and understated branding.

Include the desired adjuster and strap reference. The selected hardware and fit range are confirmed in the product specification.

styles.name: Bucket Hats

Share head circumference, crown depth and brim width, along with a fit reference. Tolerances are recorded in the approved specification.

styles.name: Ankle Socks
styles.description: Plan custom ankle socks around the short cuff height, heel coverage, knit weight, size range and artwork placement for everyday collections.

Stripe scale, logo position and pattern repeat.

Can stripes wrap around the leg?
Include the stripe widths, spacing and color sequence. Placement is reviewed against the knit repeat and sock size range.
Can heel and toe colors be different?
Yes. Mark each area on the design reference and include the yarn colors you want reviewed.
